findings.summary: Text 'slot-heading-title' holds the unbreakable run "Cluster", which measures about 111px at 29px inside a 54px box. It cannot wrap, so it will be clipped or overflow. Shorten it, allow a break, or give it a wider box.
findings.why: The compiler measured this as a disagreement between what was asked for and what the geometry resolves to.
findings.fix: Adjust the program so the geometry resolves as intended.

findings.summary: Text 'slot-heading-description' holds the unbreakable run "Operate", which measures about 70px at 18px inside a 54px box. It cannot wrap, so it will be clipped or overflow. Shorten it, allow a break, or give it a wider box.
findings.why: The compiler measured this as a disagreement between what was asked for and what the geometry resolves to.
findings.fix: Adjust the program so the geometry resolves as intended.

findings.summary: The build did not produce the geometry the plan promised: subject: planned 1200x521, built 1206x528.
findings.why: A region that had to grow to hold its content means the plan's share of the canvas was wrong, and every region below it moved.
findings.fix: Give the region the room its content needs, or reduce what it holds.
